# Frontal CLI

> Command-line interface for the Frontal platform. Wraps `@frontal-labs/sdk@1.0.4`; no raw HTTP. Project config lives in `frontal.jsonc`. Machine-readable output with `--json`; errors go to stderr as `{"error":{code,message,fix,docs,requestId,statusCode}}` with stable exit codes (0 ok, 1 general, 2 validation, 3 auth, 4 permission, 5 not found, 6 config, 10 network, 11 timeout, 12 rate limited).

Version: frontal-cli@0.1.0. Verify with `frontal --version`.

## Rules for agents

- Prefer `--json` and read stdout; errors are on stderr. Never parse human output.
- Credentials: `--api-key frt_…` or `FRONTAL_API_KEY`; `.env.local` in the project is read automatically. Never print keys — the CLI redacts them, do not work around that.
- `frontal <command> --help` always contains an `Examples:` block.
- Config files may contain comments and trailing commas (`frontal.jsonc`).
- Set `FRONTAL_CONFIG_DIR` to a scratch directory in sandboxes so `~/.frontal` is untouched.

## Commands

- `frontal init [--name <dir>] [--force]`: create `frontal.jsonc`, `.env.example`, `.gitignore` entries (`.frontal/`, `.env`, `.env.local`), `src/.gitkeep`, and `package.json` if missing. Never overwrites without `--force`. `--json` returns `{dir,name,created,updated,skipped,kept}`.
- `frontal types [--out src/frontal-configuration.d.ts] [--env <name>]`: generate `FrontalEnv`, `FrontalVars`, `FrontalSecrets`, `FrontalServices` (typed SDK client per enabled service via `import("@frontal-labs/sdk").Frontal`), `FrontalProject`; augments `NodeJS.ProcessEnv`. Header `// Generated by frontal types — do not edit.` `--json` returns `{out,changed,services,vars,secrets}`.
- `frontal auth login [--method browser|api-key] [--auth-url <url>]`: browser PKCE login or validated API key; stores into the active profile.
- `frontal auth password-login --email <e> --password <p>` / `frontal auth signup --email <e> --password <p>`: public auth API (no credentials needed).
- `frontal auth whoami [--local]`: local credential status plus `GET /auth/account/profile`; `--local` skips the API.
- `frontal auth logout` / `frontal auth token` / `frontal auth refresh`: manage the stored session.
- `frontal auth mfa <status|setup|enable --code|disable --code|verify --code|backup-codes-regenerate>`.
- `frontal config <set <k> <v>|get <k>|list|reset|profiles|use <profile>|telemetry>`: `~/.frontal/config.json` profiles.
- `frontal workflows list [--limit --cursor]` / `create --body <json>` (validated against the SDK `WorkflowDefinitionSchema`) / `search --body` / `batch --body` / `run get <wf> <run>` / `run summary <wf> <run>` / `run timeline <wf> <run>` (SSE; `--json` emits NDJSON lines `{type,data,id}`).
- `frontal runs <list|create --body>`; `frontal invocations create --body`; `frontal events <list|get <id>|query --body|usage --body|reprocess --body>`.
- `frontal completion <bash|zsh|fish>`; `frontal migrate-legacy`.

Planned (not yet in this version): `dev`, `env pull|push`, `deploy`, `promote`, `rollback`, `logs`, `policy check`.

## Global flags

`--json`, `--yaml`, `--quiet`, `--verbose` (or `FRONTAL_DEBUG=1`), `--debug`, `--env <dev|staging|prod>`, `--api-key`, `--api-url`, `--profile`, `--yes`, `--no-color`, `--watch [s]`, `--until field=value`.

## frontal.jsonc

```jsonc
{ "$schema": "https://frontal.dev/schemas/frontal.jsonc", "name": "my-app", "env": "dev",
  "apiUrl": "https://api.frontal.dev/v1",
  "services": { "ai": { "remote": false }, "agents": { "remote": false }, "graph": { "remote": false } },
  "vars": {}, "secrets": { "required": ["FRONTAL_API_KEY"] } }
```

Valid service keys: agents, ai, audit, auth, billing, blob, connectors, data, datasets, events, governance, graph, integrations, lineage, observability, ontology, pipelines, sandbox, schedules, webhooks, workers, workflows. Overlay files `frontal.<env>.jsonc` are deep-merged with `--env`.
